title: Crawldad payload v1
description: Normative structure of a Crawldad v1 automation payload. Leaf expressions/templates are strings validated by the semantic pass, not this schema; this schema fixes the document shape, the node vocabulary (exactly one recognised head per node), and the mandatory loop safety cap.

name.description: Logical identity of the managed payload.

inputs.description: Typed parameters bound at run time.

type.description: The input's declared type. `backend` resolves to a `{ adapter, options }` backend binding; `storageTarget` to a download sink; `secretRef` is a vault REFERENCE only (never the secret) consumed solely by `fill.secret`; the rest are ordinary JSON value types.

required.description: Whether a run must supply this input. A required input missing at run start fails the run before any work.

default.description: The value bound when a run omits this input (any JSON value of the declared type). Only meaningful when `required` is false or absent.

config.description: Session config. Only `backend` (the adapter-resolution Expr) is required; every other block is optional. The launch/context/route blocks become the SessionPolicy a real adapter applies; `retry` drives the resilience layer.

backend.description: Expr resolving to the { adapter, options } backend binding.

defaultTimeoutMs.description: Context default timeout and the interpreter's timeout-hierarchy floor; 120000 when absent.

deadlineMs.description: Run wall-clock cap for an async run, enforced by the executor saga's timeout; a generous default (30 min) when absent.

screenshotOnFailure.description: Whether the executor captures a page screenshot on a step failure, stored in deletable blob storage with only its ref in the trace; true when absent, set false to disable.

strictExtraction.description: When true, ANY extraction selector miss — a `text`/`innerText`/`innerHtml`/`attr` whose target matches no element — fails the run terminally with `selector_miss` (the default severity of a `require(...)`-wrapped extraction, applied to every extraction). When false (the default) a miss is soft: it increments `stats.selectorMisses` and emits a `SelectorMiss` event once per distinct selector, but the run still succeeds. A matched-but-empty element (or a matched element merely lacking the attribute) is legitimately blank data, never a miss.

captureOnFailure.description: On a step failure, serialise the failing page's full HTML and stream it — content-addressed, exactly like a `capture` node — to a tenant BYO `storageTarget`, recording a `Captured` event with only its blob ref (never the HTML). The diagnostic companion to `screenshotOnFailure`: the failing DOM is the clearest signal of selector drift. Absent ⇒ disabled (there is no default target; unlike `screenshotOnFailure`, which uses the operator's own screenshot store, this needs a customer target). Captured on the durable/async execution path, like `screenshotOnFailure`.

to.description: An Expr (resolved against `input` at setup, like `config.backend`) resolving to the `storageTarget` the failing page's HTML streams to. A `to` that does not resolve to a registered sink fails the run at setup with `invalid_capture_target` / `unknown_capture_sink`.

launch.description: Browser launch options passed to a launching backend.

context.description: Browser context options applied at connect.

route.description: Request-interception policy applied per page: abort by host/resource type, else cache, else throttle.

cacheResourceTypes.description: Resource types served from the cross-run asset cache (stylesheet/script).

cacheUrlSuffixes.description: URL suffixes served from the cache (.html/.js).

throttle.description: Global serialized throttle for non-cached requests.

minIntervalMs.description: Minimum spacing between non-cached requests; 0 disables throttling.

retry.description: Operation-level resilience, wrapping the whole program.

retryOn.description: The only retryable conditions (timeout/pageCrashed); everything else is terminal.

onPageCrashed.description: Page-crash handling (reopenPage → close+reopen on the same context).

vars.description: Initial variable bindings, evaluated once in order. A string value is an Expr; a non-string is a JSON literal.

result.description: Final Expr shaping the response body.

block.description: An ordered list of nodes (a step list or a control-flow body).

sel.description: A selector: a CSS/xpath string, or a structured object rooted at EXACTLY ONE of css/xpath/text/role/title/base, with optional refinements. `role` may carry an accessible-name `name`; `base` may pair with a relative `css` (the sole two-root combination). Only the keys the engine's SelResolver implements are permitted.

css.description: Root at a CSS selector (`page.Locator`). The string form's default engine; a Tmpl.

xpath.description: Root at an XPath expression (Playwright's `xpath=` engine). A Tmpl.

text.description: Root at the innermost element containing this text (`GetByText`, normalised substring). A Tmpl.

role.description: An ARIA role (a fixed vocabulary, not a Tmpl) — page.GetByRole. The WAI-ARIA role set the real backend's AriaRole enum accepts, so an unknown role fails at save rather than run.

name.description: The accessible name that narrows `role` (`GetByRole` name option, substring/case-insensitive). A Tmpl; valid only with `role`.

title.description: Root at an element by its `title` attribute (`GetByTitle`). A Tmpl.

base.description: Root relative to a bound locator var (a child locator); may pair with a relative `css` (the sole two-root combination).

in.description: Resolve inside a bound frame handle — the var a `frame` node bound.

nth.description: Select the nth match, 0-based (`.Nth`). An Expr evaluating to a whole, non-negative number (a long, or an integral-valued double such as 2.0, coerced like an array index). A non-integral value (2.5, or a computed 5.0/2) is a terminal type_error; a negative index — 0-based nth has no from-the-end meaning and the backends diverge on it — or one past int.MaxValue is a terminal index_out_of_range. A bare non-integral or out-of-range literal is rejected at save time with the same code; an integral-valued double is accepted and coerced.

filter.description: Narrow the locator to matches whose text matches a regex (`.Filter(HasTextRegex)`).

hasTextRegex.description: A regex the retained matches' text must contain (a Tmpl).

allOf.$comment: `name` is meaningful only as the accessible name of a `role`.

oneOf.$comment: Rooted by a selector engine at the page/frame — exactly one root, and `base` absent.
Rooted at a bound handle — `base`, optionally narrowed by a relative `css`; no other root.

numExpr.description: An integer loop bound: either an Expr string that evaluates to a whole number, or a typed JSON number literal. A number N behaves exactly as the Expr "N" (an integral literal ⇒ long, else double), so the two forms are interchangeable. The loop counter is an integer, so a non-integral value — a fractional literal (2.5) or a computed non-integer (5.0/2) — is a terminal type_error; a bare non-integral literal is rejected at save time with the same code, while an integral-valued double (2.0) is accepted and coerced.

class.description: `terminal` is never retried; `retryable` is retried per `config.retry` then surfaces as `retryable-exhausted`.

code.description: A stable machine slug the caller branches on (author-chosen for `fail`/`guard`).

message.description: A human-readable description (a Tmpl — `${…}` interpolates run values).

node.description: One step: an object with exactly one recognised head key. An unknown head, or more than one head, matches no branch and fails.

comment.description: A no-op annotation: ignored at execution and exempt from validation. The only node with a bare-string body.

goto.description: Navigate the page to a URL (`page.GotoAsync`).

url.description: The destination URL (a Tmpl — `${…}` interpolates run values).

waitUntil.description: Playwright load state to await before the step completes (e.g. `load`/`domcontentloaded`/`networkidle`/`commit`).

timeoutMs.description: Per-node timeout override in milliseconds; falls back to `config.defaultTimeoutMs`.

waitForLoadState.description: Wait for the page to reach a lifecycle load state (`WaitForLoadStateAsync`).

timeoutMs.description: Per-node timeout override in milliseconds; falls back to `config.defaultTimeoutMs`.

waitForRequest.description: Run `trigger`, then wait for the HTTP request it provokes (`RunAndWaitForRequestAsync`) — the postback-wait idiom.

urlPrefix.description: Match requests whose URL starts with this prefix (a Tmpl).

method.description: Optional HTTP method to match (e.g. `POST`); any method when absent.

timeoutMs.description: Per-node timeout override in milliseconds; falls back to `config.defaultTimeoutMs`.

trigger.description: The nodes that provoke the awaited request (e.g. a `click`), run while the wait is armed.

waitFor.description: Wait for a selector to reach a DOM state (`Locator.WaitForAsync`).

in.description: Resolve the selector inside a bound frame handle.

timeoutMs.description: Per-node timeout override in milliseconds; falls back to `config.defaultTimeoutMs`.

frame.description: Bind a frame locator to a var so later actions/selectors can target it with `in` (`page.FrameLocator`).

var.description: The variable the frame handle binds to.

selector.description: A CSS selector for the iframe element.

addStyleTag.description: Inject a `<style>` tag into the page (`AddStyleTagAsync`) — e.g. to force hidden tabs visible.

in.description: Resolve the selector inside a bound frame handle.

timeoutMs.description: Per-node timeout override in milliseconds; falls back to `config.defaultTimeoutMs`.

fill.description: Type into a field. Exactly one value source: `value` (an Expr, ordinary data) XOR `secret` (a `input.<name>` reference to a secretRef input). A `secret` is resolved from the vault at fill time and never enters the expression value space; `value` and `secret` are mutually exclusive.

value.description: The value to type — an Expr over ordinary run data (mutually exclusive with `secret`).

secret.description: A `input.<name>` reference to a secretRef input; resolved from the vault at fill time (never interpolated, never an Expr).

in.description: Resolve the selector inside a bound frame handle.
Resolve the selector inside a bound frame handle.

screenshot.description: Capture a full-page PNG to the tenant's deletable screenshot blob store, recording only the content-addressed ref in the trace — the same seam, retention, and tenant partitioning as screenshot-on-failure (never the image). `name` is an optional author label (Tmpl) carried into the trace/timeline to correlate the shot; it does not affect the content-addressed ref.

name.description: Optional author label (a Tmpl) carried into the trace/timeline to correlate the shot; it does not affect the content-addressed ref.

locate.description: Bind a lazy, re-queried locator handle to a var for reuse in later actions/selectors and DOM reads. Root it at a `selector` (page/frame) or derive it `from` a bound handle.

var.description: The variable the locator handle binds to.

selector.description: Root the handle at a page/frame selector. Provide this or `from`.

base.description: Root the handle relative to another bound locator var (a child locator).

in.description: Resolve inside a bound frame handle.

from.description: Derive the handle from another bound locator var (e.g. `rows` → `rows.Nth(i)`). Provide this or `selector`.

nth.description: Select the nth match, 0-based (`.Nth`). An Expr evaluating to a whole, non-negative number (a long, or an integral-valued double such as 2.0, coerced like an array index). A non-integral value (2.5, or a computed 5.0/2) is a terminal type_error; a negative index — 0-based nth has no from-the-end meaning and the backends diverge on it — or one past int.MaxValue is a terminal index_out_of_range. A bare non-integral or out-of-range literal is rejected at save time with the same code; an integral-valued double is accepted and coerced.

filter.description: Narrow the handle to matches whose text matches a regex (`.Filter(HasTextRegex)`).

hasTextRegex.description: A regex the retained matches' text must contain (a Tmpl).

download.description: Run `trigger`, capture the browser download it provokes, and stream the bytes to the `to` storageTarget under their content-addressed identity. Storage is idempotent by content hash — an already-present blob short-circuits to `stored:true` with no re-upload — so a stable artifact is de-duplicated automatically, no author key required. (`idempotencyKey` was removed: content addressing already delivers that `stored:true` dedup, and a pre-fetch key skip would need per-tenant key→blob state kept coherent with retention plus author warrants against upstream drift and skipped trigger side-effects.)

trigger.description: The nodes that provoke the browser download (e.g. a `click` on a file link).

to.description: An Expr resolving to the `storageTarget` the bytes stream to.

var.description: The variable bound to the download result `{ contentId, sha256, sizeBytes, storedAs, stored }`.

timeoutMs.description: Per-node timeout override in milliseconds; falls back to `config.defaultTimeoutMs`.

capture.description: Serialise the current page's full document (the doctype and the `<html>` element itself — the complete serialised DOM, NOT `innerHtml('html')`) or, with a `selector`, that element's subtree (its `outerHTML`), and stream the UTF-8 bytes to the `to` storageTarget under their content-addressed identity. Symmetric with `download`: idempotent by content hash (an already-present blob short-circuits to `stored:true` with no re-upload), and tenant-scoped. The captured document is the customer's OWN content going to the customer's OWN storage, so it NEVER passes through the credential-param scrubber (a `token=`/`apiKey=` substring in the page survives verbatim) — only the resulting blob ref (a hash) is bound and traced. Bind the REF, never the content, so `result` returns a compact manifest of refs instead of megabytes of HTML.

to.description: An Expr resolving to the `storageTarget` the serialised HTML streams to.

selector.description: Capture this element's subtree — its `outerHTML` (the element itself plus its descendants). When absent, the whole document is captured (doctype + `<html>`).

in.description: Resolve the `selector` inside a bound frame handle.

var.description: The variable bound to the capture result `{ contentId, sha256, sizeBytes, storedAs, stored }` — the ref manifest entry.

set.description: Bind or update a run variable (interpreter state). With `path`, deep-set into an object/array var.

path.description: Optional deep path into the target (e.g. `[${indent}]`); when absent, sets the whole var.

value.description: The value expression (an Expr; a JSON literal is expressed as its Expr form).

push.description: Append a value to an array var (interpreter state) — the accumulate-output-list idiom.

into.description: The array variable to append to (must already be an array).

log.description: Emit a `LogEmitted` trace event. A `warning`/`error` is not a failure — the run continues.

level.description: The log level. `warning`/`error` still continue the run.

fail.description: Raise a typed failure unconditionally — e.g. an unreachable `else`. A `terminal` class is never retried.

guard.description: Assert a condition or raise a typed failure: `cond` must hold, else `elseFail` is raised.

cond.description: The condition that must hold (an Expr).

elseFail.description: The typed failure raised when `cond` is false.

if.description: Conditional branch: run `then` when `cond` is true, else the optional `else`.

switch.description: Multi-way branch: run the `do` of the first `case` whose `when` is true, else `default`. Sugar over nested if/else.

cases.description: Ordered boolean cases; the first true `when` wins.

do.description: Nodes run when `when` is the first true case.

loop.description: A bounded loop with a mandatory `maxIterations` cap. Exactly one of `for` (numeric counter) or `while` (do-while condition).

maxIterations.description: The mandatory safety cap — the most iterations the loop may run. Exceeding it is terminal `max_iterations_exceeded` unless `onMaxIterations` is `warn`.

onMaxIterations.description: At the cap: `fail` (terminal, the default) or `warn` (log a warning and stop).

for.description: Numeric-counter form: bind `var` from `from` to `to` by `step`.

var.description: The loop counter variable (visible only in the body).

to.description: The end bound (see `inclusiveTo`/`exclusiveTo`; the default is exclusive-style `i < to` per authored use).

while.description: Do-while condition form: run the body, then continue while this Expr is true. The only checkpoint-resumable loop form.

forEach.description: Iterate an array value or a bound locator's matches, binding each item to `as` (and its position to `index`). Mandatory `maxIterations` cap.

in.description: The array value or bound locator var to iterate (an Expr).

as.description: The item variable (visible only in the body).

onMaxIterations.description: At the cap: `fail` (terminal, the default) or `warn`.

break.description: Exit the enclosing loop. With `when`, only when the Expr is true; bare = unconditional.

when.description: Optional condition; break only when the Expr is true.

continue.description: Skip to the enclosing loop's next iteration. With `when`, only when the Expr is true.

when.description: Optional condition; continue only when the Expr is true.

checkpoint.description: A durable resume anchor for a long-running top-level `while` loop: reaching it records the `cursor` + a variable snapshot, so a killed run resumes here against a fresh session. Placement is save-time-validated (`checkpoint_misplaced`/`checkpoint_not_unique`).

name.description: The checkpoint's stable name — the durable resume anchor.

cursor.description: Expr → the resumable cursor value persisted at this savepoint (a page cursor / resume URL).

resume.description: Nodes run ONLY on resume, before the enclosing loop continues, to re-establish the browser at the cursor; the restored cursor is bound to the `checkpoint` var.
